stories.headline: İmamoğlu prosecution deepens: new IBB arrests, espionage trial proceeds, TCMB paper quantifies economic shock
stories.summary: The prosecution of jailed Istanbul Mayor Ekrem İmamoğlu expanded this week with a new wave of 12 arrests across three provinces targeting IBB road maintenance and IT units on alleged tender fraud. Separately, the 'political espionage' trial continued at Silivri—İmamoğlu delivered a courthouse statement, a key state's witness retracted testimony, and CHP leader Tanrıkulu visited İmamoğlu in prison. A TCMB technical working paper, circulated without naming İmamoğlu, found that the shock to FX demand from the March 2025 operation was statistically comparable to the Iran war shock.

stories.headline: TCMB releases revised inflation report raising 2026 interim target from 16% to 24%, signals no rate cuts
stories.summary: The Central Bank published its Q2 2026 Inflation Report, revising the year-end interim inflation target sharply upward to 24% (from 16%) and the end-year forecast to 26%, attributing the revision to the Iran war shock on energy prices. Governor Karahan stated that tightening remains an option if inflation deteriorates, ruled out rate cuts, and conducted a regional business-sector consultation tour in Konya. International banks (Deutsche Bank, ING, Citi) revised their forecasts following the report; the market participants survey also showed rising expectations.

stories.headline: MİT dismantles 9-person spy network working for two foreign intelligence services; 7 arrested in 4-city operation
stories.summary: Turkey's National Intelligence Organization (MİT) announced it had dismantled an espionage network whose members collected sensitive information about Turkish NGOs, ethnic groups, and civil servants on behalf of two unidentified foreign intelligence services. In a coordinated operation across four provinces, 7 suspects were detained and subsequently arrested; two others were already imprisoned on separate charges. The network leader is identified only by initials B.E.

stories.headline: Foreign Minister Fidan conducts intensive Iran-war diplomacy: Qatar visit, Hormuz calls, Al Jazeera interview
stories.summary: Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan visited Doha (May 11-12), meeting Qatar's Emir and PM, calling for the Hormuz Strait to stop being used as a weapon and warning that the ceasefire alternative is renewed war. Fidan gave a wide-ranging Al Jazeera interview calling Israel 'the elephant in the room' and urging US-Iran negotiations. He also condoled a Hamas political bureau member whose son was killed in Gaza. On May 17 he held a phone call with Iran's foreign minister discussing the US-Iran negotiation process.

stories.headline: CHP holds 109th 'Millet İradesine Sahip Çıkıyor' rally in Balıkesir; Özel calls for snap elections
stories.summary: CHP held its 109th 'Millet İradesine Sahip Çıkıyor' protest rally in Balıkesir on May 17, in response to the ongoing prosecution of İmamoğlu and other CHP-affiliated mayors. Leader Özgür Özel called for snap general elections, warned İmamoğlu may not be released and said the party has other presidential candidates. İmamoğlu sent a written message from Silivri prison read to the crowd. Earlier in the week Özel also appeared at an İzmir event demanding early elections.

stories.headline: PKK peace process stalls after Iran war outbreak; MİT contacts Kandil, security report expected within 10 days
stories.summary: Reuters reported that the Iran war outbreak two weeks after parliament issued Kurdish peace process recommendations has stalled progress on both sides. Separately, pro-government sources claimed MİT is in active contact with PKK leadership in Kandil seeking a disarmament roadmap, and that a security report on next steps is expected within 10 days. AKP sources confirmed talks continue but declined to confirm the Kandil contact specifically. MHP leader Bahçeli's proposal to grant Öcalan a formal coordination status met resistance within AKP.

stories.headline: AKP holds Kocaeli youth festival with Erdoğan; 'İyi ki Erdoğan' cabinet hashtag campaign triggers internal and opposition controversy
stories.summary: Erdoğan attended an AKP Youth Branches 'Gençlik Şöleni' at Kocaeli stadium on May 16, featuring a drone light show. Cabinet ministers simultaneously launched an 'İyi ki Erdoğan' social media campaign. The event generated controversy on multiple fronts: students alleged they were misled into attending under the guise of a concert trip; an AKP insider publicly criticised the event's content; the MC Eser Yenenler was targeted because of a past pro-İmamoğlu social media post; and conservative figures debated video of attendees dancing.

stories.headline: Erdoğan attends Turkish States Organization informal summit in Kazakhstan, calls for Turkic world tech cooperation amid Hormuz crisis
stories.summary: President Erdoğan traveled to Türkistan, Kazakhstan for the informal summit of the Organization of Turkic States (May 13-15), where he called for deeper cooperation in technology, AI, defense industry, and the 'Common Corridor' transport route, citing the Hormuz Strait crisis as evidence of the strategic value of alternative Eurasian corridors. He met bilaterally with Uzbek President Mirziyoyev on the sidelines and addressed the presence of Turkish Cypriots at the summit.
